Rashi on Nedarim 32b:10:1.english: There is no [difference] between one prohibited by vow [from deriving] benefit from his fellow - That his fellow prohibited him by vow not to derive benefit from him in any manner.

Rashi on Nedarim 32b:10:2.english: [And] one who is forbidden by a vow [benefit] from his food - For he only forbade him by a vow [from] the benefit of food.

Rashi on Nedarim 32b:10:3.english: Except setting foot - To pass through his courtyard and shorten his path.

Rashi on Nedarim 32b:10:4.hebrew: וכלים - ולהשתמש בכלים של מדיר שאין עושין בהם מאכל. דמודר הנאה אסור בדריסת הרגל — דהיינו הנאה שמקצר דרכו — ולהשתמש בכליו, אבל מודר ממנו מאכל מותר בשתיהן, לפי שזה לא הדיר ממנו אלא מאכל:
Rashi on Nedarim 32b:10:4.english: And utensils - And to use utensils of the one who imposed the vow with which food is not prepared. For one forbidden by vow from [deriving] benefit is forbidden from setting foot [on his property] — which is a benefit in that he shortens his path — and from using his utensils; however, one forbidden by vow from [his] food is permitted in both of them, because this [person] only forbade him by vow [from] food.

Rashi on Nedarim 32b:12:1.hebrew: מאן תנא - דמודר הנאה אסור בדריסת הרגל ובכלים וכו', אע"ג דלא מיחזי הנאה:
Rashi on Nedarim 32b:12:1.english: Who is the tanna - [who taught] that one prohibited by vow from deriving benefit is prohibited from setting foot [on the vower's property] and from [using] utensils, etc., even though it does not appear [to be] a benefit.

Rashi on Nedarim 32b:12:2.hebrew: רבי אליעזר היא דאמר אפילו ויתור כו' - ויתור זהו כגון שלקח מדה של תפוחים בפרוטה, ולאחר שמדד לו המדה מוסיף לו שתים או שלשה, וזהו דרך של חנוונין להוסיף על המדות משלהן. הואיל ובלא תנאי נותן לו, לא מיחזי כמקח אלא כמתנה, ואליבא דרבי אליעזר אסור המודר באותו הויתור של מדידת פירות. הכא נמי, אף על גב דדריסת הרגל לא הויא הנאה גמורה, אסור:
Rashi on Nedarim 32b:12:2.english: It is Rabbi Eliezer, who said: Even vittur, etc. - Vittur is, for example, where one bought a measure of apples for a perutah, and after [the seller] measured out the measure for him, he adds two or three [more] for him — and this is the practice of shopkeepers, to add onto the measures from their own [stock]. Since he gives [it] to him without [any] stipulation, it does not appear like a purchase, but rather like a gift, and according to Rabbi Eliezer, the one prohibited by a vow [from deriving benefit] is forbidden [to accept] that extra allowance in the measuring of produce. Here too, even though treading with the foot is not a full-fledged benefit, it is prohibited.

Rashi on Nedarim 32b:1:1.hebrew: שס"ד ימים אית ליה וכו' - וימי השנה שס"ה ימים:
Rashi on Nedarim 32b:1:1.english: He has 364 days, etc. - And the days of the year [are] 365 days.

Rashi on Nedarim 32b:1:2.english: He enthroned him - He gave him dominion.

Rashi on Nedarim 32b:2:1.english: These are: two eyes - For after he was circumcised, he was complete in all his limbs.

Rashi on Nedarim 32b:2:2.english: The tip of the sex organ - [This] is the [male] organ.

Rashi on Nedarim 32b:5:1.hebrew: מעשרה שליטים - שהן מועילין לגוף יותר מעשרה שליטים, ואלו הן כו':
Rashi on Nedarim 32b:5:1.english: More than ten rulers - For they [repentance and good deeds] are more beneficial to the body than ten rulers, and these [ten rulers] are, etc.

Rashi on Nedarim 32b:6:1.english: He brought it out - [Referring] to the priesthood.

Rashi on Nedarim 32b:7:1.english: Due to the words of Melchizedek - the priesthood was taken from him.

Tosafot on Nedarim 32b:10:1.hebrew: אין בין המודר הנאה וכו' אלא דריסת הרגל - במקום דלא קפדי אינשי, כגון בקעה בימות החמה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 32b:10:1.english: There is no [difference] between one who is forbidden by vow [from deriving] benefit, etc., except setting foot - In a place where people are not particular, such as a valley in the summer.

Tosafot on Nedarim 32b:11:1.hebrew: ולא ישאילנו נפה וכברה - אבל לא נקט מחבת ופיטפוט שלא ישאילנו, דהא פשיטא שלא ישאיל, דהנאה המביאה לידי מאכל הוא; אלא אפי' נפה וכברה, שאינו יכול לאכול אחר תיקון זה בכלי זה, אלא צריך תיקון אחר — אפייה ובישול — אפ"ה אסור לשאול לו נפה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 32b:11:1.english: And he may not lend him a sieve or a strainer - However, [the Mishnah] did not mention a frying pan or a trivet [as utensils] that he may not lend him, because it is obvious that he may not lend [them], since [lending them] is a benefit that leads directly to food. Rather, [it teaches that] even [regarding] a sieve and a strainer — where one cannot eat [the food] after this preparation with this utensil, but rather it requires another preparation, [namely] baking or cooking — even so, it is forbidden to lend him a sieve.

Tosafot on Nedarim 32b:11:2.hebrew: מקום שמשכירים אסור - דחשיב הנאת מאכל ממה שנהנה השוכר, וראוי לקנות מן המעות מאכל:
Tosafot on Nedarim 32b:11:2.english: [In] a place where they rent [such items] out, it is prohibited - Because it is considered a food benefit from what the renter benefits, and it is fit to buy food with the money.

Tosafot on Nedarim 32b:12:1.hebrew: מני ר"א היא - ומיירי בבקעה בימות החמה, דלא קפדי, כדפרישית. וא"ת: ולוקמה הכא בחצר, דקפדי וכ"ע? וי"ל: דא"כ הוה ליה מקום שמשכירין, והיה אסור במודר מאכל:
Tosafot on Nedarim 32b:12:1.english: Whose [view] is this? It is [that of] Rabbi Eliezer - And [the Mishnah] is speaking of an open field during the summer months, where [people] do not mind, as I explained [above]. And if you ask: Let us establish [the Mishnah] here [as referring] to a courtyard, where [people] — and [in fact] everyone — object? [The answer is that] one can say: If so, it would be a place that [people] rent out, and it would be prohibited to one prohibited by vow from [another's] food.

Tosafot on Nedarim 32b:12:2.hebrew: אפי' ויתור - שמוותר לו כדרך המוכרין. ומתני' דלעיל דמוכר בפחות ולוקח ביותר, מסתברא דאתי כר"א:
Tosafot on Nedarim 32b:12:2.english: Even vittur [conceding] - That he concedes [something] to him, as is the way of sellers. And [regarding] the Mishnah above, of one who sells for less and buys for more, it is reasonable that it accords with Rabbi Eliezer.

Tosafot on Nedarim 32b:2:1.hebrew: שתי עינים וב' אזנים וראש הגוייה - ראש האבר שנימול, ושמע וראה ושלט בעיניו ואזניו, שהמצות מפקחות את העינים והאזנים, כדכתיב (דברים כ״ט:ג׳): "ולא נתן ה' לכם לב לדעת ועינים לראות ואזנים לשמוע עד היום הזה". אבל הכא לא קחשיב לב, דהא כתיב (נחמיה ט׳:ח׳): "ומצאת את לבבו נאמן לפניך וכרות עמו הברית", ונדר על המילה; אלמא קודם המילה היה כבר לבו שלם לשמים:
Tosafot on Nedarim 32b:2:1.english: Two eyes, and two ears, and the tip of the body [rosh hageviyyah] - [This refers to] the tip of the organ that was circumcised, and he [thereby] heard and saw and gained mastery over his eyes and his ears, for the commandments open the eyes and the ears, as it is written (Deuteronomy 29:3): "Yet the Lord has not given you a heart to know, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, until this day." However, here [the Gemara] does not count [the] heart, for it is written (Nehemiah 9:8): "And You found his heart faithful before You, and made the covenant with him," and [that] vow was regarding circumcision; thus, before the circumcision, his heart was already whole toward Heaven.

Tosafot on Nedarim 32b:6:1.hebrew: להוציא כהונה משם - תימה, דאברהם נמי היה מזרעו של שם! וי"ל: דמכל בניו של שם קאמר, ולבסוף ניטל משאר בניו וניתנה לאברהם לבדו. א"נ י"ל: לפי שלא היה בכור בכל בניו, ולא היה לו לירש הכהונה מן הדין אלא דוקא הבכור:
Tosafot on Nedarim 32b:6:1.english: "To bring forth the priesthood from Shem" - [This is] astonishing, for Abraham was also from the seed of Shem! And one can say that [the Gemara] means from all of Shem's descendants, and in the end it was taken from the rest of his descendants and given to Abraham alone. Alternatively, one can say [that the Gemara's statement is necessary] because [Abraham] was not the firstborn among all of [Shem's] descendants, and by law he would not have [been entitled to] inherit the priesthood, rather only the firstborn [would].
